_classes.name: reprinted_gender_neutral drop fires on real non-gender changes
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='reprinted_gender_neutral' AND the quote's span in the packet holds a [deletion] or a braced piece that is not a gender pronoun phrase (GENDER regex)
db_examples: 2009-A1002 dropped: 'poll clerk or Election inspector shall c...'
2009-A10634 dropped: 'No such claims shall be audited or order...'
2009-A11352 dropped: 'the chair shall also in the same manner...'
_classes.note: rule caught S8345 but not the A8691 seizure drop (span match failed), so 128 is a floor

_classes.name: on_effective_date on a deadline anchored to an undated event
_classes.rule: deadline_kind=='on_effective_date' AND (deadline_text not null OR quote ~ /no later than|not later than|prior to|within \w+ (days|months|years) (from|of|after)/i)

_classes.name: named NYC or local actor left Unspecified
_classes.rule: agency=='Unspecified' AND actor_raw ~ /\b(city|tlc|commission|department|board|town|village|county|commissioner)\b/i AND NOT actor_raw ~ /section|application|act/

_classes.name: 'will'/'must' duty stored as power
_classes.rule: powers file AND quote ~ /\b(will|must) \w+/ (excluding 'must not be required')

_classes.name: same provision stored twice (identical quote, or content clause of a stored duty)
_classes.rule: same matter_id+agency+file with quotes equal after trimming trailing punctuation (catches -04 only; the 5-500 repeats differ by 'email'/'e-mail' and content clauses need judgment)

_classes.name: reprinted sentence whose only new matter is 'or successor agency'
_classes.rule: quote contains 'successor agency' AND every braced piece in its packet span is 'or successor agency'/'tlc' AND no deletion in the span
_classes.note: 2 of 7 (2011-A8691-01, -23) are false positives: -23 sits in a wholly new section, -01 carries other changes outside the quote

_classes.name: extends_existing true on wholly new act sections (and false on added classes)
_classes.rule: proxy: extends_existing true AND quote's packet span has no deletion and no braced piece beyond the pre-2017 uppercase artifacts (Hail, tlc, Such, Any...)
_classes.note: proxy also flags -41/-42 (ext true correct, quote wrong); the false-direction cases (A6575) need judgment

_classes.name: act-clause sentence stored as a record
_classes.rule: first 80 chars of the normalised quote appear in effective_dates[law].raw_clause
_classes.note: recurrence of the act_clause class the gate should drop

_classes.name: sunset extension with no named holder stored as a duty
_classes.rule: quote ~ /expire and be deemed repealed/ AND agency=='Unspecified' AND duties file
_classes.note: 53 Unspecified sunset records in both files; 13 are duties

_classes.name: private or individual obligation stored as a duty
